backend/servers/api-server/src/services/voice_commands.rs:531-556 — action_contact_manager() returns a hardcoded placeholder email (manager@example.com / spravca@example.com / spravce@example.com) in response_text, ssml, the VoiceCard.content, AND the data.manager_email field, all with success:true. It never resolves the device's building/org real manager contact (the VoiceAssistantDevice parameter is bound as _device and unused).

This is the live Alexa/Google voice-webhook handler (voice_commands is the production voice command dispatcher and a repeat churn hotspot). A resident asking their assistant to 'contact the manager' is read back a fabricated example.com address as if it were real contact info.

Distinct from the 2026-08-20 api-core finding on action_book_facility (voice-facility-contact-fabricated-success): different intent handler, different defect class — fabricated PII/contact data returned to the user rather than a fabricated booking-success.
